h1: Custom LED Drinkware from Idea to Production
lead: Explore custom LED drinkware, light-up cups, LED ice buckets and branded bar accessories. Review product models, logo options, LED configuration and the production workflow for your project.
html:
Questions Before You Order

What are your payment terms?

We require a 30% deposit. The remaining 70% must be paid in full before shipment.

Which payment methods do you accept?

We accept T/T (bank transfer), Western Union and Alipay.

Which currencies can I pay in?

We accept USD, CNY, EUR and GBP. Other currencies can also be arranged for your order.

Which trade terms do you offer?

We offer EXW (Ex Works), FOB Shenzhen, C&F and DDP. The trade term is agreed with you for each order.

How is an LED drinkware project different from adding a logo to an existing cup?

An LED drinkware project coordinates the vessel body, lighting configuration and artwork together. If you have selected an existing LED cup, send its model to start with that product configuration.

Can you show the brand artwork before an LED drinkware project goes into production?

Yes. We provide a free design proposal and visual mockup showing the artwork on the selected vessel. Electronic components remain outside the print and laser-marking scope.

Compare the Relevant Products and Service

Email Us for Free Design and a Project Quote
